title: Huntik Magazine
summary: Huntik Magazine is a comic book series based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. It was released monthly in Italy and Europe by Tridimensional S.r.l. and Kappa Edizioni, beginning in March 2009 and ending in February 2012. In total, 18 issues were released, despite a 19th issue being ready for publication and a 20th being pencilled.

sections.heading: Contents
sections.wikitext: Each issue consisted of a new comic book story, accompanied by character profiles, features on a specific Titan type, fact files on real-life legends and historical locations in a ''Place of Mystery'' section, and several exclusive posters or gifts. It also allowed readers to send in their own Titan ideas to which the artists would draw their idea which would then be shown in the ''Your own Titans'' section.

sections.text:
Number: 01
Title: The School of Mystery
Issue: 1
Released: IT March 2009
Synopsis: Lok and Sophie discover that their classmate and enemy, Ford, a brilliant student of the Venice Preparation Academy, is also Seeker, working for the Organization.

Number: 02
Title: The Titan of the Forest
Issue: 2
Released: IT April 2009
Synopsis: The Huntik team travel to Sherwood Forest to find the Titan of Robin Hood, Arawn the Hunter. However, the forest is guarded by a mysterious archer, and the Organization have sent their men to recover the Titan.

Number: 03
Title: The Fire of Georgiopolis
Issue: 3
Released: IT May 2009
Synopsis: The Huntik team is after the legendary lance of Saint George, Ascalon, and enlist the help of Tel Aviv Huntik Foundation agent Gil, but Ryder is determined to gain the artifact for the Organization.

Number: 04
Title: The Treasures of Alexandria
Issue: 4
Released: IT June 2009
Synopsis: The Huntik team set out to sea to recover the four Amulets of the Tritons. However, Gregor and another Organization agent, Captain Caine, are not going to make the quest easy for them.

Number: 05
Title: The Carnival of Deception
Issue: 5
Released: IT July 2009
Synopsis: It's carnival time in Venice! But not everyone is safe. The Organization are planning something sinister. With people in masks everywhere, the Huntik team are unsure who they're against as they investigate the Medallion of Saint Mark.

Number: 06
Title: The Titan's Island
Issue: 6
Released: IT August 2009
Synopsis: On their way to a new mission, the Huntik team's jet is attacked by the Organization, and they crash land on a mysterious island. Trapped in a strange, valley Lok and Cherit must fight off giant birds and rescue the rest of the team from the giant Titan, Polymaximus.

Number: 07
Title: The Headless Horseman
Issue: 7
Released: IT September 2009
Synopsis: A mysterious Titan is wreaking havoc in Sleepy Hollow in New York, and it's up to Huntik team to solve the mystery and put a stop to it, to save the locals and keep the Seeker world a secret.

Number: 08
Title: The Curse of Venice
Issue: 8
Released: IT November 2009
Synopsis: The team clash with Ford and his gang to take control of an ancient magic sword. However things go from bad to worse when Ford gets away and the Legendary Titan of the Deeps, Grand Dragon Leviathan awakens.

Number: 09
Title: Grand Dragon Leviathan
Issue: 9
Released: IT February 2010
Synopsis: The Legendary Titan of the Deeps, Grand Dragon Leviathan, is causing devastation to the city of Venice. The Huntik team battle to save the city before it's too late.

Number: 10
Title: Mission to Skara Brae
Issue: 10
Released: IT April 2010
Synopsis: The team run into an Professor Rickman, an old enemy of Dante's while on a mission to the Neolithic settlement of Skara Brae in Scotland.

Number: 11
Title: The Seekers of Ys
Issue: 11
Released: IT June 2010
Synopsis: The Huntik team land in Brittany as they embark on a treasure hunt, following clues that lead them to the statue of Gradlon the Great, the Bay of Death and finally to the mythical lost city of Ys.

Number: 12
Title: The Lost City of Casterwill
Issue: 12
Released: IT September 2010
Synopsis: In the underwater city of Ys, the Huntik team battle Professor Rickman and Captain Caine but they are soon joined by Ford, Ryder and Gregor and all seems lost. In a twist of fate, Ford is double crossed by the Organization and Lok chooses to save him.

Number: 13
Title: The Secret of the Flying Dutchman
Issue: 13
Released: IT November 2010
Synopsis: A new Organization team, led by Diaz and Snake, pursue the Huntik team as they try to track down the coveted Titan Ghostfog that haunts the Flying Dutchman, a ghostly ship.

Number: 14
Title: Cerberus
Issue: 14
Released: IT January 2011
Synopsis: Dante has gone missing, so Zhalia leads the team to find the Amulet of Cerberus. They are forced to make a deal with Rahmas, an Organization mercenary who has dealings with the sinister Dr. Benway.

Number: 15
Title: The Titan of the Stage
Issue: 15
Released: IT March 2011
Synopsis: Ford joins the Huntik team on a mission to find Todd, a member of the Monsterok band who has gone missing. As Dante Vale and Ford investigate deeper, they soon encounter Lee Roy, a dangerous Organization Seeker who is after Todd's Titan, Thunderok.

Number: 16
Title: The Bulls of Pamplona
Issue: 16
Released: IT August 2011
Synopsis: Sophie receives an invitation from a distant relative and goes with the team to an abandoned house. But it's a trap set up by Snake, who takes Cherit hostage as he and Diaz are still hellbent on reclaiming Ghostfog's Amulet.

Number: 17
Title: The Power of Kronos
Issue: 17
Released: IT November 2011
Synopsis: The Huntik team attack Dr. Benway's base in order to recover his Legendary Titan of Time, Kronos. but everything goes wrong when Kronos sends Lok and Sophie back in time to the 17th century. Can they correct the past to change the future and find their way home?

Number: 18
Title: The Guardian of Yonaguni
Issue: 18
Released: IT February 2012
Synopsis: When a Foundation agent, Emi, comes to the Huntik team for help, they travel to Japan and dive down to the underwater island of Yonaguni. There they battle Wilder and the Organization for the Amulet of Kyojin.

full_text:
Huntik Magazine is a comic book series based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. It was released monthly in Italy and Europe by Tridimensional S.r.l. and Kappa Edizioni, beginning in March 2009 and ending in February 2012. In total, 18 issues were released, despite a 19th issue being ready for publication and a 20th being pencilled. 

==Contents==
Each issue consisted of a new comic book story, accompanied by character profiles, features on a specific Titan type, fact files on real-life legends and historical locations in a Place of Mystery section, and several exclusive posters or gifts. It also allowed readers to send in their own Titan ideas to which the artists would draw their idea which would then be shown in the Your own Titans section.

==Comics List==

==Unreleased Comics==

==Trivia==
*The magazine often featured free gifts including two exclusive Panini miniatures, the first being Cherit in Issue 01, and the second being Gareon in Issue 07. An exclusive Willblade sword was included with Issue 18.
